```artifact
Feature: Alarms for Various Conditions
  As a user of the device,
  I want to be alerted to critical conditions,
  So that I can take appropriate action.

  Scenario: GUI triggers alarm when input air line is blocked
    Given the input air line is blocked
    When the system checks the air line pressure
    Then the GUI should display a HIGH severity alarm

  Scenario: GUI triggers alarm when input O2 line is blocked
    Given the input O2 line is blocked
    When the system checks the O2 line pressure
    Then the GUI should display a HIGH severity alarm

  Scenario Outline: Device and GUI trigger alarm for inspiratory pressure below threshold
    Given the inspiratory pressure is <pressure> cm H2O
    When the system checks the inspiratory pressure
    Then the GUI should display an alarm

    Examples:
      | pressure |
      | -5       |
      | -4       |
      | -3       |

  Scenario: GUI triggers alarm when input O2 line pressure is too high
    Given the input O2 line pressure is 61 cm H2O
    When the system checks the O2 line pressure
    Then the GUI should display a HIGH severity alarm

  Scenario: Controller triggers alarm when GUI is unresponsive for 1/2 of the apnea time
    Given the GUI is unresponsive for 1/2 of the apnea time
    When the controller checks the GUI responsiveness
    Then the controller should trigger an alarm

  Scenario: GUI displays an overpressure alarm
    Given the pressure exceeds 60 cm H2O
    When the system checks the pressure
    Then the GUI should display an overpressure alarm

  Scenario: Controller triggers alarm when controller is unresponsive for 1/2 of the apnea time
    Given the controller is unresponsive for 1/2 of the apnea time
    When the system checks the controller responsiveness
    Then the controller should trigger an alarm

  Scenario: Controller triggers overpressure alarm above 60 cm H2O
    Given the pressure is 61 cm H2O
    When the system checks the pressure
    Then the controller should trigger an overpressure alarm
```
